evidenceLimits: Complete parsed native/public UI equality and31byte-equal original PNGs establish source provenance, not whole-frame game GPU equality.
Default native normal-font scale, glyph baselines, colored shadows, fractional pixel snapping, compound stack anchors and degenerate1pixel nine-slice rules require same-state native capture.
The inventory_item_renderer for3D blocks and banner_pattern_renderer are custom engine paths; the library exposes caller-supplied previews and does not fabricate artwork.

Selection backgrounds, recipe focus links, enablement, effect states, cursor rules and item rendering data come from native backend bindings. Public controlled props do not pretend to reproduce their gameplay algorithms.
Fixed desktop Classic main-panel profiles do not certify pocket/mobile layout, all viewport sizes, external toolbars/help chrome or every native interaction.

Five matching lossless native images now corroborate the specifically recorded local facts. They do not establish complete native-screen pixel-perfect acceptance, all backend states or custom banner/block renderer fidelity.
